adminSteps: Open a customer. The title bar holds a pill More actions with a caret and prev/next arrows. Opened from script by clicking the s-internal-button whose commandfor is 'action-group-menu-More actions' (a pointer click did not open it in the hidden tab). Menu opens below the pill with a search field 'Search actions' at the top, then six items in one group: Send account invite, Issue store credit, Merge customer, Request customer data, Erase personal data, Delete customer (red). Order's menu and confirm modals not measured. Hover not measured.
